limits: The actual admission failure is qualifying evidence for this mutant, not evidence that its originally anticipated watchdog failure occurred. The restored 2/0 and byte-identical preserved library remain distinct from the failed original controller.
method: Read-only source and retained log reconciliation; no test rerun or receipt overwrite.

observed_failure.interpretation: The blocking send admits the overflow after the existing writer timeout frees queue capacity. The overflow-refusal assertion detects that admission regression. This is not a parent-watchdog detection.
observed_failure.parent_reason: Child exited 101; its captured stdout/stderr were included in the assertion diagnostic.
observed_failure.peer_secondary_failure: The release sender drops during the child assertion unwind; the waiting peer then reports RecvError.

parser_failure: The controller expected one terminal summary in the combined outer log. The parent diagnostic embeds the child summary, so two 0/1 summaries appear. The original controller stopped before the queued-wait variant and retained complete=false.
source_audit: After removing only the two named test bodies and the cfg(test) no_wait module declaration, retained baseline candidate and original-head remember.rs are identical. Production and Group B assertions/timeouts are unchanged.
